title: Say his name
how: Say his name one time. The second he looks at you, say "Yes!" and give a treat. Do it 5 times.
win: He looks at you fast every time.

title: Name while he sniffs
how: Wait until he is sniffing the ground. Say his name once. Mark "Yes!" and treat when he looks up.
win: He turns to you even when busy.

title: Easy sits
how: Hold a treat at his nose and lift it up and back. When his bottom hits the floor, say "Yes!" and treat. Do 5.
win: He sits when you ask.

title: Sit and count
how: Ask for a sit. Count to 3 in your head, then say "Yes!" and treat. Next try, count to 5.
win: He holds the sit while you count.

title: Sit and step away
how: Ask for a sit and say "stay." Take 2 steps back, then step back in and treat. Do not call him to you.
win: He stays sitting while you step away.

title: Sit while I clap
how: Ask for a sit. Clap your hands once. If he stays, say "Yes!" and treat. Too hard? Clap softer.
win: He holds the sit when you clap.

title: Easy downs
how: From a sit, lure a treat down to the floor and out. When he lies down, say "Yes!" and treat. Do 5.
win: He lies all the way down.

title: Down and relax
how: Ask for a down. Count slowly to 10, dropping a treat between his paws every few counts.
win: He holds a down for 10 seconds.

title: Tiny stays
how: Ask for a sit and say "stay." Count to 2, then say "Done" and treat. Add one count each try.
win: He waits for the word "Done."

title: Stay while I walk
how: Put him in a stay. Take 3 steps to the side, then walk back and treat. Always go back to him.
win: He holds while you move around.

title: Stay by the door
how: Ask for a stay near a door. Touch the doorknob. If he holds, say "Yes!" and treat. Build up to opening it.
win: He stays even when the door moves.

title: Find your bed
how: Toss a treat onto his mat. When he steps on, say "Place," then "Yes!" and treat on the mat. Do 5.
win: He goes to his mat when asked.

title: Place during a snack
how: Send him to Place. Sit nearby and eat a snack. Treat him on the mat every few seconds for staying.
win: He stays on his mat while you eat.

title: Place while I cook
how: Send him to Place. Open the fridge or rattle a pan. Treat him on the mat for not getting up.
win: He holds Place through kitchen noises.

title: Closed-fist leave it
how: Hold a treat in a closed fist. When he stops sniffing and backs off, say "Yes!" and treat from the OTHER hand.
win: He backs away from your fist.

title: Leave the floor treat
how: Put a treat on the floor under your hand. Say "leave it." When he backs off, mark "Yes!" and treat from your other hand.
win: He turns away from a treat on the floor.

title: Four on the floor
how: When he jumps up, wait. The second all four paws are on the floor, say "Yes!" and treat down low.
win: He keeps his paws on the floor for treats.

title: Drop it for a trade
how: While he holds a toy, show a treat and say "drop it." When he lets go, mark "Yes!" and trade the treat. Do 5.
win: He opens his mouth on "drop it."

title: Two-toy trade
how: Play with one toy, then bring a second toy to life. When he drops the first for it, say "Yes!" Swap back and forth.
win: He happily gives up a toy.

title: Come for a party
how: From a few steps away, open your arms and say "Come!" in a happy voice. Big party and a treat when he gets there.
win: He runs straight to you.

title: Ping-pong recall
how: Two people, a few steps apart. Take turns calling "Come!" Treat and cheer each time he arrives. Move farther apart.
win: He races back and forth to you.

title: Come past a toy
how: Have someone hold a toy nearby. From a few steps away call "Come!" Throw a big party when he reaches you.
win: He comes even with a toy out.

title: Bump my hand
how: Hold out a flat open hand near his nose. When he bumps it, say "Yes!" and treat from your other hand. Do 5.
win: He touches your hand with his nose.

title: Touch from far
how: Hold your hand out a few steps away and say "Touch!" He should come bump it. Treat. Step farther each time.
win: He runs over to touch your hand.

title: Catch him being calm
how: When he lies down on his own, quietly walk over and drop a treat between his paws. No words. Do it a few times.
win: He chooses to lie down and relax.

title: Walk with me
how: Walk a few steps. Treat him at your side when the leash is loose. If he pulls, stop like a tree until it loosens.
win: He walks next to you without pulling.
